reader_notes: “överröstar” (a verb of sound) is used of light drowning out the horizon glow; the metaphor works but jars slightly until “dränker” later normalises the image.
The text alternates between the uncommon compound “vägljus” and the more idiomatic “vägbelysning”/“armatur” without signalling any difference.
Real fältgentiana closes rather than opens toward evening; the night-opening/night-scent claim is invented. Harmless for the comprehension task, but factually loose for a science-flavoured passage.
